intro: Dandred's Fold is a secluded farmstead and manor tucked along the misty northwestern shores of Lordamere Lake in the Alterac Mountains. Now overrun by the Syndicate, it serves as a secure hideout for Lord Aliden Perenolde and his co-conspirators. Both the Horde and the Alliance keep a watchful eye on this lakefront retreat for very different reasons.

sections.t: A Noble Safe Haven Fallen to Outlaws
p: Perched on the western edge of the Uplands with private access to the waters of Lordamere Lake, Dandred's Fold was once a tranquil country estate, likely owned by an Alteraci noble named Dandred. In the aftermath of the kingdom's fall, the estate transformed into a fortified enclave for the Syndicate. Syndicate assassins and enforcers now patrol its fences and docks, shielding the fallen nobility from the eyes of Southshore authorities and the Forsaken across the lake.
